From b648ce2a28ba83c4fa67c61fcc5983e15e9d4afb Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001

Date: Tue, 2 Apr 2024 16:51:47 +0300
Subject: [PATCH] drm/i915/mst: Reject FEC+MST on ICL
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

ICL supposedly doesn't support FEC on MST. Reject it.

Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Fixes: d51f25eb479a ("drm/i915: Add DSC support to MST path")
Reviewed-by: Uma Shankar <uma.shankar@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Ville Syrjälä <ville.syrjala@linux.intel.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20240402135148.23011-7-ville.syrjala@linux.intel.com

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/display/intel_dp.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/display/intel_dp.c
index 819f3234de03..a11bc4fd3d65 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/display/intel_dp.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/display/intel_dp.c
@@ -1418,7 +1418,8 @@ static bool intel_dp_source_supports_fec(struct intel_dp *intel_dp,
 	if (DISPLAY_VER(dev_priv) >= 12)
 		return true;
 
-	if (DISPLAY_VER(dev_priv) == 11 && encoder->port != PORT_A)
+	if (DISPLAY_VER(dev_priv) == 11 && encoder->port != PORT_A &&
+	    !intel_crtc_has_type(pipe_config, INTEL_OUTPUT_DP_MST))
 		return true;
 
 	return false;
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/i915/display/intel_dp.c`**
   - A condition was added to the function `intel_dp_source_supports_fec`. The new condition checks if the display version is 11, the encoder's port is not PORT_A, and the current configuration does not involve DisplayPort Multi-Stream Transport (MST). If all these conditions are met, the function will return `true`, indicating that FEC (Forward Error Correction) is supported. This change effectively rejects the use of FEC in conjunction with MST on ICL (Ice Lake) platforms.

### Relationships

- The modification in `intel_dp.c` is directly related to the bug fix regarding the incompatibility of FEC with MST on ICL platforms. The patch addresses a specific issue introduced by a previous commit (identified by the Fixes tag) that added DSC (Display Stream Compression) support to the MST path. By rejecting FEC when MST is in use, the patch ensures that the system behaves correctly and avoids potential issues that could arise from this unsupported configuration.

Here is the commit message:
drm/i915/mst: Reject FEC+MST on ICL
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

ICL supposedly doesn't support FEC on MST. Reject it.

Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Fixes: d51f25eb479a ("drm/i915: Add DSC support to MST path")
Reviewed-by: Uma Shankar <uma.shankar@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Ville Syrjälä <ville.syrjala@linux.intel.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20240402135148.23011-7-ville.syrjala@linux.intel.com

Here is the root cause:
The root cause of the bug is that Ice Lake (ICL) platforms do not support Forward Error Correction (FEC) when using DisplayPort Multi-Stream Transport (MST). The existing code incorrectly allowed FEC to be enabled under certain conditions when MST was active, which could lead to compatibility issues and potential display failures.

Here is the patch:
 
 static bool intel_dp_source_supports_fec(struct intel_dp *intel_dp,
 					 const struct intel_crtc_state *pipe_config)
 {
 	struct intel_encoder *encoder = &dp_to_dig_port(intel_dp)->base;
 	struct drm_i915_private *dev_priv = dp_to_i915(intel_dp);
 
 	if (DISPLAY_VER(dev_priv) >= 12)
 		return true;
 
-	if (DISPLAY_VER(dev_priv) == 11 && encoder->port != PORT_A)
+	if (DISPLAY_VER(dev_priv) == 11 && encoder->port != PORT_A &&
+	    !intel_crtc_has_type(pipe_config, INTEL_OUTPUT_DP_MST))
 		return true;
 
 	return false;
 }
